# Verify no duplicate code in bump_build
import inspect
from semver.version import Version
source = inspect.getsource(Version.bump_build)
lines = source.split('\n')

print("bump_build source lines:")
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    print(f"  {i}: {repr(line)}")

# Check for consecutive identical non-empty statement groups
duplicates_found = False
for i in range(len(lines)-1):
    stripped_i = lines[i].strip()
    stripped_next = lines[i+1].strip()
    if stripped_i and stripped_i == stripped_next:
        print(f"\nDUPLICATE FOUND at lines {i}-{i+1}: '{stripped_i}'")
        duplicates_found = True

if not duplicates_found:
    print("\nNo consecutive identical statements found ✓")
